purpose: Shared transport-neutral DevOps contract for static React HTML clients and authorized ChatGPT connectors via admitted Universal Terminal and Universal Transputer

event_replay.guarantee: Durable original terminal journal, monotonic event identifiers, gap detection, readback before display; no synthetic SUCCESS

invariants: Event publication only after original terminal/transputer readback
Never expose GitHub credentials to HTML client
Native issue processing via existing GitHub issue events, no timer automation
Source, CI, merge, runtime and EFFECT_ACK_DONE are separate evidence domains
SSE transport availability is not claimed by this contract
Origin, CSRF, CORS, authorization and replay protection required
All clients consume the same canonical events and distinguish receipt, execution, CI, merge and productive effect
ChatGPT interface changes require platform support; a repository contract alone does not enable ChatGPT-native streaming or tool connectivity

chatgpt.read: Connector/MCP read of the same persisted terminal snapshots and event journal; no assertion of continuous SSE in a chat session
chatgpt.write: Explicit owner-authorized connector/MCP action carrying identical command schema and nonce; persist receipt and read back terminal state
chatgpt.limitations: ChatGPT client UI is platform controlled; repository code cannot replace its native interface or create an always-running chat session
